sources.stations.load: line.json: sum over the station's ops of variant mix x human mean time, divided by bays
sources.stations.loadRatio: line.json: mix-weighted station load / (takt x bays)
sources.stations.blockedShare: events_current.json (seed 42), window t >= 1800 s (simulate/params.py WARMUP): time in the last start/end/blocked/starved state, averaged over bays
sources.stations.starvedShare: events_current.json (seed 42), window t >= 1800 s (simulate/params.py WARMUP): as blockedShare
sources.stations.bottleneck: top 3 stations by loadRatio, plus any with loadRatio > 1
sources.sparks: graph.synth noisy segments (synthetic from event log, seed 1) from events_current.json (seed 42), window t >= 1800 s (simulate/params.py WARMUP); t = (start - 1800) / (9000 - 1800); node = graph.build's own cluster assignment
sources.graph.nodes: graph.build on the synthetic segments (catalogue = parts, variants, stations of line.json); meanTime/cv/n over the segments in each cluster
sources.graph.nodes.gx: longest-path layer over hard + soft edges, normalised to [0, 1]
sources.graph.nodes.gy: position within the layer, ordered by station then median offset in the visit
sources.graph.nodes.hx: as gx/gy but layered over hard edges only, so reorderable (soft) ops share a layer
sources.graph.edges: line_v2 edges from graph.build; nab/nba = visits seen in each order (within station only); redundant = within-station pairs seen in order that the builder dropped as implied
sources.swarm.points: story/swarm.py sampler (seed 7): random designs on optimize.generator candidates(line, 'B4', floor 0.9) plus 1-4-step mutations of line_solver_1..3 (near 1-3); near 4 = rebuild space (optimize/rebuild.py rules: open station count and order, 1-3 bays, fixed equipment alone): random layouts and mutations of line_rebuild_1
sources.swarm.winners: winner 0 = line_rebuild_1.json (optimize.rebuild), 1-3 = line_solver_1..3.json (optimize rebalance); cost re-scored here and equal to each design's objective
sources.swarm.cost: solver objective, EUR over 3 years: 270000 per human bay (estimate) + robot rent x 36 months + integration (capability/robots.json, estimate) per bay + lever costs once (line.json levers, estimate); rebuild-space designs pay optimize.rebuild BAY_COST per extra bay instead of decouple/regroup
sources.swarm.rate: units/h capacity proxy: min over used stations of 3600 x bays / mix-weighted station load (no cap at 3600/takt; ignores blocking, starving and robot failures)
sources.swarm.ok: optimize/model.py rules: hard precedence (transitive), one staffing per station, mixed-model takt with peak tolerance 1.1 (estimate); mobile-robot sharing ignored
